about: Labelled role decisions for Norvale. Labels were written before any model was run on these cases.
sources: probe-*: observations from /data/runs/probe-3d/business/trace.jsonl, with reorder_target_qty and requested_change derived by the same rules the company code uses. rule-* and trap-*: made from those observations by rule.
excluded: Probe orders 1 and 4 (some lines needed, some not) and reorder requests CARB, FRG-ALO, FRG-OCN, LAS (stock exactly at the requested level) have no single defensible label.
scoring: label is the preferred action; acceptable lists every action counted correct. Wrong approval: approve* on a non-approval label. Wrong refusal: non-approval on an approve label.
